approval_ref: The active user goal requires continued efficiency, accuracy and adaptability improvements for RFI, Submittal and email content.
notes: Reject keyword-only workflow matches, preserve roleless RFI uncertainty, and normalize only explicit common Submittal statuses.
Email attachments remain inert until the user explicitly selects one for local import; automatic recursion is not authorized.
title: Workflow identifier accuracy and selected email attachment import
objective: Reduce deterministic RFI/Submittal misclassification and let a reviewer explicitly import an EML attachment without manual file extraction or automatic recursive analysis.
